title: A Deep Dive into Life as a CLO Intern - Heard Some People Regret It!? 👀
description:
🎓 Three rising stars in the fashion world, starting from campuses in Shanghai, have dived into the digital fashion universe of CLO. Let’s see if their stories can ignite the spark of fashion in your heart!

At CLO, you’ll find that digitalization is not just a solution but a mindset—it makes design bolder and fashion more sustainable.  
At CLO, you’ll learn not only about the digital processing of fabrics but also how to use 3D technology to create designs that are both realistic and full of creativity. By building 3D scenes, you can even bring virtual fashion shows to life, making garments move...

This internship journey offers profound insights into the future trends of the apparel industry. Through digital transformation, the fashion industry can achieve improvements in both efficiency and cost!

📣 If you’re passionate about fashion digitalization and eager to make your mark in the fashion world, CLO is waiting for you to explore! We can’t wait to see more talented individuals use CLO to create their own fashion universe! 🪐🌠🚀
transcript:
Hello, everyone. I'm Li Xiaoyu, an intern. I've been an intern for two months. Do you want to know about our internship life?  
Hi, my name is Li Xiaoyu. I'm from Shanghai Engineering University.  
I majored in Fashion and Art Design. I'm currently studying at Yan San University.  
I will graduate in June 2025.  
Before I came here, I had been studying Close 3D for nearly three years.  
And I also obtained an advanced certificate from Close 3D.  

Hello, everyone. I'm Chen Luming.  
I'm from Donghua University's Fashion and Art Design School.  
I'm a student in the Chinese-Japanese cooperation major.  
I took an entrance exam in July this year and came to Close company for an internship.  
My main job is to measure and assess fabric.  

What kind of life does it take to be an intern at Close 3D?  
I started my internship with training.  
Here I have been dealing with fabric digitization.  
The accuracy of fabric digitization is also very important for the restoration of virtual clothing.  
In addition, for those who plan to come to Close 3D for an internship,  
my suggestion is to have a certain initial ability.  
Because Close 3D will have an initial ability assessment before the internship.  
Everyone can learn related videos on Close 3D's Bilibili and public account.  
You can record your own problems.  
If you have the opportunity to do an internship,  
you can solve your own problems very accurately and quickly.  
You can improve your skills.  

Before coming to Close 3D, I did not practice processing fabric, physics, and textiles.  
I just listened to how to operate in class.  
After coming to Close 3D, I had the guidance and training of all the teachers.  
Then I can practice better.  

In terms of fabric, it is divided into physics and textiles.  
Physical processing is mainly for some of its stretch and curve.  
Thickness of the fabric can be measured, and others such as weight and thickness are used for making the approving.  
For particle processing, it is mainly used to make precision scanning,  
then this can be applied to all forms of software,  
in order to have more realistic real-time images.  

A lot of different types of fabric can be executed in Close 3D in real time,  
so tunneling of the product is truly interesting.  
In this process,  
I want to make some materials that may not exist in the real world.  
It can add a lot of design fun  
and some possibilities of creation.  

I hope in the future  
I can improve my level of virtual fashion production.  
And then I hope I can put some of the other software,  
some of the 3D scenes are added to the cloud,  
and then I'm going to do a walkthrough in the cloud,  
make the clothes move.  

What do you think of the future development of the clothing industry?  
I think in terms of clothing,  
as a more traditional industry,  
it needs digital intervention in all aspects  
to achieve its efficiency and cost double harvest.  

The clothing industry,  
I think it is now moving in a direction of virtualization.  
And then like us,  
that's what we're doing.  
And then it has a lot of advantages.  
There are two of them:  
that is, there is no physical and there is no physical.  
No physical means that it can  
not require  
making a real physical fabric.  
And it's very convenient and efficient.  
You don't have to do what we used to do—  
factory processing,  
which takes a lot of time and has a long cycle.  
We can do our design very quickly,  
and then you can achieve  
very bold and innovative  
effects in our design.  

And then it's sustainable.  
Since it doesn't need real fabric,  
then you don't have to think about the waste of materials,  
and some environmental issues.  
It's virtual.  
I think this direction is very good.  
That's a trend in the clothing industry right now.  

Your future for yourself—  
what plans do you have?  
My first major was not clothing,  
but I found that it has something to do with our lives,  
so I got interested in it.  
I will also improve myself through competitions.  
In September this year,  
the digital show in Beijing Fashion Week will also have my work.  

My future plans  
must still be in the clothing industry.  
But in the clothing industry,  
I prefer the digitalization of clothing.  
So I think I will, in the future,  
go further and further in the digitalization of clothing.  

Hello everyone,  
I am Andy, a technical expert of Colossandy.  
As one of the managers of this intern training,  
I saw their pursuit and love for new technology and new things.  
Now they can already have quality and efficiency  
to complete daily internship tasks.  
I believe they have a deeper understanding of the new technology and digitalization of the clothing industry.  
After graduation in the future,  
entering the industry,  
they can also carry out deep applications  
and promote the positive development of the industry.

chunks.title: A Deep Dive into Life as a CLO Intern - Heard Some People Regret It!? 👀
chunks.content: ## Introduction to CLO Internship Experience This section introduces the interns Li Xiaoyu and Chen Luming, their academic backgrounds, and initial experience with the CLO 3D internship program. It covers their majors, prior skills, and initial roles during the internship. Li Xiaoyu is an intern from Shanghai Engineering University majoring in Fashion and Art Design, currently studying at Yan San University with an expected graduation in June 2025. She has nearly three years of experience with CLO 3D software and holds an advanced certificate in CLO 3D. Chen Luming, from Donghua University's Fashion and Art Design School, is a student in the Chinese-Japanese cooperation major. He joined CLO as an intern after passing an entrance exam in July. His primary responsibility during the internship is fabric measurement and assessment. ## CLO 3D Internship Training and Fabric Digitization This section outlines the training process at CLO, emphasizing fabric digitization, its importance, and required skills. It includes insights into the initial ability assessment and recommendations for prospective interns. The internship begins with comprehensive training focused on fabric digitization, a critical step for accurately restoring virtual clothing in CLO 3D. Precision in fabric digitization directly impacts the realism of virtual garments. Prospective interns are advised to develop foundational skills before joining, as CLO administers an initial ability assessment. Learning resources are available on CLO 3D’s Bilibili channel and official public accounts. Interns are encouraged to record and address personal challenges to enhance skill acquisition efficiently. ## Fabric Properties and Processing Techniques in CLO 3D This section explains the technical aspects of fabric physics and textile processing in CLO 3D, including measurements and applications for virtual garment realism. Fabric processing in CLO 3D is divided into two main categories: physics and textiles. Physical attributes such as stretch, curve, thickness, weight, and other parameters are measured and used to simulate fabric behavior realistically. Particle processing involves precision scanning of fabric surfaces, enabling the creation of highly detailed textures that improve the accuracy of virtual fabric representation. These detailed scans can be applied across various software platforms to generate realistic, real-time images. ## Creativity and Innovation in Virtual Fabric Design This section discusses the opportunities for creativity within virtual fabric design using CLO 3D, including the creation of materials that do not exist in reality and how this expands design possibilities. CLO 3D supports real-time execution of numerous fabric types, enabling dynamic visualization of virtual garments. This capability allows designers to experiment with innovative materials that may not exist physically, fostering creative freedom and expanding potential design outcomes. The intern expressed a desire to advance skills in virtual fashion production, including integrating 3D scenes into cloud platforms for interactive cloud-based walkthroughs and animated garment presentations. ## Future Trends in the Clothing Industry: Digitalization and Virtualization This section analyzes the role of digital technology and virtualization in transforming the traditional clothing industry, highlighting efficiency, sustainability, and innovation benefits. The clothing industry is undergoing significant digital transformation aimed at improving efficiency and reducing costs.

chunks.content: This capability allows designers to experiment with innovative materials that may not exist physically, fostering creative freedom and expanding potential design outcomes. The intern expressed a desire to advance skills in virtual fashion production, including integrating 3D scenes into cloud platforms for interactive cloud-based walkthroughs and animated garment presentations. ## Future Trends in the Clothing Industry: Digitalization and Virtualization This section analyzes the role of digital technology and virtualization in transforming the traditional clothing industry, highlighting efficiency, sustainability, and innovation benefits. The clothing industry is undergoing significant digital transformation aimed at improving efficiency and reducing costs. Virtualization eliminates the need for physical fabric production, which streamlines design workflows and shortens production cycles. Digital clothing design allows rapid prototyping and fosters bold, innovative effects that are difficult to achieve with traditional methods. Additionally, virtualization contributes to sustainability by reducing material waste and environmental impact. This shift toward digital and virtual clothing is considered a major trend shaping the future of the fashion industry. ## Personal Career Plans and Aspirations in Digital Fashion This section presents the interns’ future goals, emphasizing their commitment to careers in digital fashion and participation in industry events. Li Xiaoyu initially studied a non-clothing major but developed an interest in fashion due to its relevance to daily life. She plans to enhance her skills through competitions and will showcase her digital work at Beijing Fashion Week’s digital show in September. Her long-term career focus remains within the clothing industry, specifically pursuing advancements in clothing digitalization. ## Insights from CLO Internship Manager on Intern Development This section provides perspective from Andy, a technical expert and internship manager at Colossandy, on the interns’ progress and industry readiness. Andy recognizes the interns' enthusiasm for technology and their ability to produce high-quality, efficient work during the internship. He believes their deepening understanding of fashion digitalization will enable them to contribute significantly to the industry after graduation. He anticipates that the interns will apply their skills toward promoting positive development and deeper application of digital technologies within the fashion sector.
